dialogue.text: This is where Demon Busters undergo basic training.
This'll be good for a Newbie like yourself!
Time is of the essence! Start your training at once!
First let's get you an understanding of how to move and change the camera angle.
So, you got it?
You have to constantly maintain your field of vision so do it several times until you get used to it!
Learn how to move and change the camera angle.
Do you understand how to move and change the camera angle?
Do you understand how to move and change the camera angle?
I do.
Good. Let's move on.
Now we're going to learn how to use a "Shortcut"!

Ask me if you don't know how.
Training 1-2: Set Basic Guard.
Did you set Basic Guard to the "5" "
Did you set Basic Guard to the "5" "
I set it.
Hmph. You seem to be a quick learner. Now let's continue our lesson in actual combat.
The most basic part of combat is the "Basic Attack"!
Over thinking it is a waste of time.
Ok! In the zone stretched out behind me are some 'Slimes' wriggling about.
These demons have been specifically created to train new DB's like yourself...
Therefore they won't fight back at all. They're kind of like punching bags.
You get it? They are supposed to help you practice 'Attacking'.
Take out 5 slimes! Then 'attack' training will be complete.
Let me know when you've made room for 2 more items.
Are you actually saying you don't understand how to 'Attack'?
I've seen your fighting style. You seem to have a grasp of how to 'Attack' don't you?
You seem to have a grasp of how to 'Attack' don't you?
Yes, I understand.
Good. So far you've learned attacks to eliminate demons.
But seeing as you can ONLY attack fighting strong demons is troublesome.
So in this next training I'll teach you how to use 'Guard'.
Here is a reward for you, Newbie.
10 Ointments.
These will regenerate your HP. Use them effectively.
You passed Training 1.
Alright let's continue. Here we'll learn about 'Guard'.
Let's move on to actual combat.
Defeat 3 Petras in this zone!
Defeat 3 Petras.
Huh? What happened? Get your rear in gear and let's go!
Alright. Looks like you've got the handle of 'Guard' in no time flat.
Let's teach you one more thing.
During the last training did you ever want to cancel your guard?
When you want to cancel your guard hit 'Esc'.
You can cancel other actions as well so
you can think of it this way: 'ESC'=Cancel action.
So your reward is...
Before that though you know you've already killed a lot of 'demons' up to now.
You're leveling up, aren't you?
I'll teach you more about the effects of each ability.
That was a long-winded explanation.
Take this reward of '200 Magnetites'.
Magnetite' is mainly used by 'Demon Busters' such as yourself
to summon demons you've 'Befriended'.

so it's very important.
You passed Training 2.
Here we'll learn about "Rush".

Good! You've gathered 3 'VB Training Cards'!

This time your reward is
5 Chakra Gums and 1000 Macca.
'Chakra Gums' regenerate your MP.
'Macca' is the currency we use in Tokyo.
Next is the last and final training, but don't relax yet!
You passed Training 3.
Here I'll teach you about "Expertise" which are related to developing "Skills".
So do you understand what an "Expertise" is?
I understand.
Let me teach you now about "Acquiring Skills" from Expertise.
You can't learn "Skills" if you don't master its Expertise.
However, you can use basic Skills such as "Attack" right off the bat.

Now I'll have you learn about Agi"
 50139"

How to deconstruct
There are three things you should note in particular.
First it takes 1 Catalyzer to deconstruct 1 item. No matter how many Remains you have...
You cannot deconstruct more than you have Catalyzers for.
Also remember that Deconstructing does not use up only one Catalyzer at a time.
Next when you deconstruct an item that's been stacked...
You'll automatically deconstruct as many of that item in the stack as you have Catalyzers.
If you only want to deconstruct a few items you'll need to sort the item into smaller stacks.
Also if the maximum capacity for a certain raw material is already full...
Making more of it will just make it go to waste so keep an eye on its capacity level.

Before the collapse, you would have known it without doubt.
This lab exists somewhere here within the border of Ikebukuro.
Its focus came to be on advanced bioengineering research.
The field is too complicated to study nowadays, but the technology they created is still usable.
Primarily, the tech aids in the cultivation of what they call "specialized bacteria".
Long ago, the lab's main focus was on simple pharmacological products.
However, a... certain doctor came along who used applied demonology in order to modify their research.
This led to the creation of the so-called specialized bacteria.

You need intelligence in order to operate a cultivation unit.
Knowledge of a vast array of topics will be necessary.
The first is called Alchemic Medicine." The second is "Alchemic Botany." Then

Alchemic Chi is a major part of the Cultivation Lab's research.

dialogue.text: You usually think of Ikebukuro as a pretty safe place to be.
Recently, though, there's been an inflow of some sketchy-looking people.
It's become enough of a concern that a certain someone has started to put out feelers for talented DBs.
...Talented DBs like you. What do you say? Feel like hearing more about this secret investigation?
Do you want to hear more?
Yes, I'm all ears.
Excellent!
Your job would be to track down and punish a man named Tsunagi.
He's part of the riffraff that's been encroaching on the Kannabaru area.
Were I you, I'd consider this request as nothing more than a simple "demon exorcism".
Will you accept the request?
Yes, a pox on all riffraff!
Having a hard time knowing where to find Tsunagi?
In all likelihood, he should be in the same area as the other people in Kannabaru.
If he's not there, maybe try talking to them...?
Also, this is a very delicate matter,
so please handle it on your own if possible.
Ikebukuro Demon Bash accepted.
Let's collect information on Tsunagi's current whereabouts.
Did you say Tiger's Nest"? Sorry
I'll look into it, though, and I'll try to have an answer by tomorrow.
Let's wait for the bartender's findings.
So, you were asking about some place called the Tiger's Nest?
It turns out that on the east side of where Ikebukuro used to be, there was a store called the Tiger's Den.
People loved to hang out there, reveling in the fantastic array of otaku goods they sold.
If you're still in need of answers, you might want to head over to that area in Ikebukuro.
Searching around the Tiger" there could provide some valuable clues."
Let's search for valuable clues around the Tiger" in Ikebukuro."
Huh, you that rat that's been sniffin' about? Careful. Stick your nose where it don't belong and it'll get broke.
Though... at least you're keepin' busy. I feel useless just standing here like this.
But not to worry! I like the sound of those carnival folk you hired.
They'll be along soon, so I won't be lonely anymore!
(battle)
Mwaha...haha... guess I'm just... the first to die...
But don't... don't worry... Like Tsunagi... we've formed a true bond...
Surprisingly... we... were friends...
Nice work, [Player]. Those monsters never stood a chance against you.
For Tsunagi to be connected to this affair, though... that's unexpected. What could it all mean?
Well, regardless, you should have this for all the work you've done.
This is supposedly a token of gratitude awarded to the archbishop of some church.
Make sure you take good care of it.
You receive the Archbishop's Photo.
Ikebukuro Demon Bash complete.
